# E0345: a lens maps a target field twice

Each target field is mapped once. Two mappings for one field would have to
agree on every instance, and the lens language has no way to say which wins.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: v0_0.a
		b: "x"
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0345]: b is mapped twice
 --> ship/history/1.0.thema:9:3
  |
9 |         b: "x"
  |         ^
  |
```
